The **Pokémon Yellow Version — All 220 Loadable Zone Segments** game is complete, polished, and verified in a real browser.

### What Was Completed & Refined
1. **All 220 Authentic Kanto Zone Segments (`src/data/pokeyellow-data.js`, `src/engine.js`)**:
   - Every canonical loadable zone segment from the `pret/pokeyellow` disassembly (11 Cities/Towns, 25 Routes, 96 Indoor Interiors, and 88 Dungeons/Caves, plus the 4 special ROM headers) renders 1:1 from authentic 2bpp tilesets (`.png`) and 32×32 blocksets (`.bst`).
   - Supports 4 hardware color palettes (**Reference Classic**, **Super Game Boy**, **Game Boy Color**, and **Original DMG Olive**), animated water/flower background tiles, and overworld sprite rendering.
2. **Playable Overworld & Following Pikachu (`src/app.js`, `index.html`)**:
   - Full tile-step movement (`WASD` / Arrow keys / on-screen D-pad), one-way ledge jumping, Bicycle speed toggle, automatic Surfing on water tiles, and seamless North/South/West/East map border transitions.
   - All door, staircase, cave, `LAST_MAP` indoor exit warps, and multi-floor elevators (**Celadon Mart**, **Rocket Hideout**, **Silph Co.**) are interactive.
   - Following **Pikachu** trails Red across Kanto and displays animated mood portraits and emotes when interacted with (`Z` / `Space` / `Enter` / `⚡ Check Pikachu ♥`).
3. **Wild Encounters, Trainer Battles & Pokédex Progress (`src/app.js`, `index.html`, `src/styles.css`)**:
   - Stepping in tall grass, caves, or water (or clicking any species chip in the zone inspector) triggers wild Pokémon encounters with authentic front/back sprites and Poké Ball catching.
   - Talking to Trainers, Gym Leaders, Rival Blue, Team Rocket, Elite Four, or Legendary Pokémon offers an interactive **⚔️ Battle Trainer** challenge right from the dialogue box.
   - Added a live **🔴 Caught** Pokédex counter in the top telemetry banner alongside the **Visited Zones** counter, with automatic `localStorage` persistence.
4. **Responsive Layout & Clean Console Verification (`src/styles.css`, `index.html`)**:
   - Adjusted the Game Boy console bezel, LCD viewport, D-pad/A/B controls, and inspector grid sizing so all controls fit cleanly at `1280×720` with zero overlap or clipping, and added an inline SVG icon so the browser loads with `0` console errors.
